mechanism: Vitamin C increases urinary acidification which may reduce SGLT2 inhibitor efficacy and increase risk of euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis; high-dose vitamin C may also increase oxalate levels affecting renal function.
action: Monitor renal function and urinary ketones; advise against high-dose vitamin C supplementation (>2g daily) in patients on empagliflozin; maintain adequate hydration.
